metadata.title: Understanding students’ mathematical achievement through feature selection and machine learning: Evidence from PISA 2018

design_fields.q1_rationale: The study used all plausible values and applied proper combination techniques as indicated by the mention of evaluating model performance across plausible values.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study explicitly states that it did not use sampling weights in the analysis.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study appears to use student-level models without accounting for school clustering, as there is no mention of multilevel modeling or cluster-robust standard errors.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study mentions using repeated stratified cross-validation, which indicates internal validation only, and does not report any validation on external datasets.
